overview_description.description:
How Many Days Until Ramadan is the most accurate and easy-to-use Ramadan countdown website, designed for Muslims around the world who want to stay spiritually prepared and well-organized ahead of the holy month.
Ramadan — the ninth month of the Islamic lunar calendar — is a sacred time of fasting, prayer, Quran recitation, self-reflection, and increased acts of worship. As the Islamic calendar shifts approximately 10 days earlier each year on the Gregorian calendar, knowing the exact date of Ramadan's arrival can sometimes be confusing. That's exactly why we built this tool.
Our live countdown timer shows you precisely how many days until Ramadan, broken down into days, hours, minutes, and even seconds — all adjusted to your local timezone. As soon as official moon sighting announcements are made by recognized authorities in your region, our countdown updates instantly to reflect the confirmed start date.
What makes us different:

Real-time, timezone-aware countdown
Switches to "days remaining in Ramadan" once the month begins
Highlights the final 10 nights (Laylatul Qadr period)
Covers Ramadan dates from 2025 all the way to future years
Clean, distraction-free, mobile-friendly interface

Whether you're a Muslim planning your Ramadan goals, a family coordinating Iftar gatherings, or simply someone curious about when Ramadan begins — HowManyDaysUntilRamadan.com gives you the answer instantly, every time.
Start counting down. Start preparing. Ramadan is closer than you think.
